svg.title: TOPAK I14 — ToolList.tla: the Thinker is told exactly the tools its lease may call, the list is fixed for the round, and the Observer reads the same list. Five properties, four mutations, each breaking exactly what the header says: checked by TLC, proved and certified by TLAPS
svg.desc: The module ADR-0048 §8 asks for, drawn from its own text and from every results file about it, all read at build time: the grant, the opening record and a promotion in the middle of a round; the five properties, stated over what the Thinker was actually told (ghost state the mechanism never reads); every property by every mutation, beside what the header says each must break; the witnesses; ADR-0048 §8's figures and digests, compared; every theorem and lemma; and the certified run. What is checked or proved here is of the module, not of the reference; "refused" means refused at the allowlist (its header). ADR-0048 was ratified on 2026.10.05 in Batch 34; the module's header, written before, calls it Proposed.

lemma; and the certified run. What is checked or proved here is of the module, not of the reference; "refused" means refused at the allowlist (its header). ADR-0048 was ratified on 2026.10.05 in Batch 34; the module's header, written before, calls it Proposed.

svg.text: Checked, proved and certified mean what ADR-0046 §1 says: TLC checks the mutations and witnesses at the module's constants; TLAPS proves each invariant under the hypothesis its statement names; the certified run accounts for every obligation by a route an independent checker accepted, or names LS4. Nothing here is said of the running reference.

svg.text: ① the Thinker is told List(rev, n): the granted revision's allowlist, narrowed by the lease. M_WIDE ignores the
narrowing.
② the round's topic opens with a record of the same list, before any effect. M_LATE writes it when the mechanism gets
to it.
③ a promotion (Promote, line 101) changes the latest revision, not a live round's list. M_RECOMPUTE re-delivers the list.

ToolListIsExact, ListFixedForRound,
OpeningRecordFirst, OpenedListIsTold

Key. ① to ③ are the grant, the opening record and a promotion; ④ a call by the Thinker, which is havoc: "it calls any tool, told or not" (the header). Red marks where each mutation acts. The picture is the diagram's own drawing of the definitions below.
"Two bundle revisions with different allowlists, so that a promotion in the middle of a round changes which tools exist": Allow == [r \in Revs |-> IF r = 1 THEN {"t1", "t2"} ELSE {"t2", "t3"}]

Not modelled: the rendering and its size bound; purpose text, which nothing checks (ADR-0048 §5); the other reasons a call may be refused (the floor's other entries, the bundle's input checks), so "refused" here means refused at the allowlist. One principal, any
number of rounds.

text.tspan: The five properties, and how each is shown

g.text: "under a live lease the Thinker was told the allowlist of the granted revision,
narrowed by the lease: no more and no fewer"
"no admitted call names a tool the Thinker was not told of, and no call is refused for
a tool it was told of"
"under a live lease, what the Thinker was told is what it was told at the grant"
"no effect is recorded on a round's topic before its opening record"
"the list in the opening record is the list the Thinker was told: the Observer reads

text.tspan: The mutations: what each does, and what the header says it must break

g.text: a promotion re-delivers the list from the new revision to a live round. Must break ToolListIsExact, ToldMatchesDecided, ListFixedForRound and
Promote, line 104: /\ told' = IF Mut = "M_RECOMPUTE" /\ lease.live THEN List(r, lease.narrow) ELSE told
the list ignores the lease's narrowing. Must break ToolListIsExact and ToldMatchesDecided.
List, line 79: List(rv, n) == IF Mut = "M_WIDE" THEN Allow[rv] ELSE Allow[rv] \cap n
a call is decided against the latest revision and not the lease's. Must break ToldMatchesDecided and nothing else.
DecideRev, line 108: DecideRev == IF Mut = "M_DECIDELATEST" THEN latest ELSE lease.rev
the opening record is written when the mechanism gets to it, not at the grant. Must break OpeningRecordFirst and nothing else.
Grant, line 87: /\ IF Mut = "M_LATE"; WriteOpen, line 96: /\ Mut = "M_LATE" /\ lease.live /\ ~opened

text.tspan: Every property by every mutation, read from

svg.text: Every mutation is run on every property, and breaks exactly the ones the header names (compared at build time): ADR-0048 §8's "27 rows: the five hold, each of the four mutations breaks exactly the properties the module says and no other, and six witnesses are reached, a promotion in the middle of a round among them".

A round is granted at revision 2, whose list holds t3.
A call to a tool the latest revision allows, and the round's does not, is refused.
